title: OAA EXP-01 SIEM webhook config (v1)
description: Versioned configuration for the generic SIEM webhook exporter (integrations/siem/webhook.py). The endpoint URL is env/config only; no credentials are ever carried here.

url.description: Ingestion endpoint. Must be https:// unless allow_http is explicitly true. Overridable by OAA_SIEM_WEBHOOK_URL.

allow_http.description: Opt-in plaintext for localhost fixtures only.
